label: Find ROIs
purpose: Rank regions where something happens to small objects, for review in the viewer
useWhen: Too many fragments to track, but you want the few places where they are taken up
Building a review queue for the viewer's ROI list
notWhen: You need per-object tracks: use tracking

params.label: Name
params.tip: Output name → rois/<name>.json; reviews are kept per name

params.label: Candidates
params.tip: The objects scored and clustered into ROIs, e.g. fragments

params.label: Mask channel
params.tip: Optional: a channel to threshold into a mask, e.g. CD169 for macrophages

params.label: Partners
params.tip: Optional: objects whose nearness raises a candidate's score, e.g. big fragments

params.label: Nuclear
params.tip: Optional: candidates in here and not in Membrane score as naked nuclei

params.label: Membrane
params.tip: Optional: the membrane population paired with Nuclear

params.label: Mask contact
params.tip: Weight for being inside or next to the mask

params.label: Density
params.tip: Weight for many candidates close together

params.label: Turnover
params.tip: Weight for a neighbourhood that fills or empties between frames

params.label: Naked nucleus
params.tip: Weight for Nuclear-but-not-Membrane candidates

params.label: Partner
params.tip: Weight for being next to a partner object

params.label: Threshold
params.tip: Smoothed intensity above which a voxel is in the mask; 0 = Otsu

params.label: Smoothing (µm)
params.tip: Gaussian smoothing before thresholding

params.label: Min volume (µm³)
params.tip: Mask pieces smaller than this are dropped

params.label: Contact reach (µm)
params.tip: How fast the contact cue fades with distance from the mask

params.label: Density radius (µm)
params.tip: Neighbourhood for the density and turnover cues

params.label: Partner reach (µm)
params.tip: How fast the partner cue fades with distance

params.label: Score quantile
params.tip: Only objects above this score quantile are clustered

params.label: Cluster radius (µm)
params.tip: How close high scorers must be to form one ROI

params.label: µm per frame
params.tip: How far one frame counts in µm when clustering in time

params.label: Window (frames)
params.tip: Longest time window per ROI; 0 = no limit

params.label: Min objects
params.tip: Fewest high scorers that make an ROI

params.label: Max ROIs
params.tip: Keep the top ROIs by score

params.label: Padding (µm)
params.tip: Margin added around each ROI box
